testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.onboarding.OnboardingContentTest

testcase.name: onboarding says the key is not checked before the first message
the key hint and placeholder follow the selected provider
a failed save surfaces the error and restores the button
a successful save advances and restores the button
the provider slot names the selected provider
saving disables the button and says what it is doing
the heading promises provider models without a model count
choosing a provider dispatches its id
a blank key keeps start chatting disabled
a free-tier provider is labelled in the slot and the menu
the reveal toggle flips the key mask
